headline: Discussion of a possible MBTA Accessibility public forum and its dates, plus updates on the MOD Grant and Lions Club collaboration.
summary: Amanda Spartichino of NortheastArc Autism Support Center will speak as a guest. The agenda also includes the Commission's annual report and a proposal to recognize December 3 as International Day of Persons with Disabilities.
items: Guest speaker Amanda Spartichino from NortheastArc Autism Support Center
Discussion of MBTA Accessibility public forum and possible dates
Vision 2026: T I E S H E R R R A Framework, with seven areas assigned to members

New business not known before the meeting
